label: lem:linear_decomp_exists
title: Existence of linear sieve decomposition
statement: Every composite integer $m\le n$ admits a linear sieve decomposition.
proof: Let $p$ be the least prime factor of $m$ (exists by \ref{lem:lpf_exists}) and set $a = m/p$. Then $(a,p)$ satisfies all conditions by \ref{lem:lpf_monotone_along_decomp}.
